raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On a Mamba + sliding-window model under `--enable-unified-memory`, a decode step could retract a request while the prefix cache held many evictable tokens.

The tri-pool chain's decode capacity check calls `ensure_capacity`, then evicts from the tree with `float_reclaim_satisfied` as the stop predicate: the tree skips eviction while the reclaim certificate (the END flushes, or a FLOAT high-side target) says the allocation can already be realized. `ensure_capacity` tries the END and FLOAT certificates once, and when neither holds it falls back to `relieve_for_alloc`. Relief flushes the ENDs and moves FLOAT pages, which can open a FLOAT certificate that was closed when it was checked, while still leaving the allocation short. `ensure_capacity` then returned False without realizing it; the eviction predicate held, so nothing was evicted, and the check failed with the cache full of evictable entries.

## Modifications

`ensure_capacity` (`mem_cache/kv/alloc/interim.py`, `_FloatChainPolicy`) now realizes the END or FLOAT certificate once more after a relief that falls short, through one helper, `_realize_token_certificate`, shared with the first attempt.

Test (CPU), `test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_unified_tri_pool.py`: `test_a_failed_ensure_leaves_no_reclaim_certificate`: under seeded random admission, window-slide, finish and state-slot churn, with lazy and with eager compaction, every failed `ensure_capacity` leaves the reclaim certificate false and the byte accounting intact. On main it fails 10 cases (the same five states under each compaction mode); with this PR the whole file passes.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable: the change decides when the allocator realizes capacity it can already reach; no forward path changes.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

SM90, main `76d5b3ce02`, `thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small`, TP 8, `--attention-backend fa4`, `--speculative-algorithm EAGLE --speculative-draft-model-path thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small --enable-multi-layer-eagle --speculative-num-steps 8 --speculative-eagle-topk 1 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 9 --speculative-use-rejection-sampling`, `--enable-unified-memory`, radix cache, overlap scheduler, CUDA graphs on, with #46376 applied (100 requests of 512 input / 4096 output tokens, concurrency 128; 192 requests sharing a 4096-token prefix + 128 tokens, 2048 output tokens, concurrency 192). The run without this fix retracted once (the line is logged once per rank, 8 lines); the run with it did not retract. Other runs without the fix logged 0 to 32 such lines, so retractions are occasional: treat this as supporting evidence, and the test above as the proof. Throughput was not compared.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+    # -- the reclaim certificate and ensure_capacity --
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _churn_step(rng, allocator, requests, slots, page_size):
+        """One random event: admit a request, slide its window, finish one, or
+        take or return a state slot."""
+        op = rng.random()
+        if op < 0.4:
+            indices = allocator.alloc(rng.randint(1, 4) * page_size)
+            if indices is not None:
+                requests.append([indices, True])
+        elif op < 0.6 and requests:
+            request = requests[rng.randrange(len(requests))]
+            if request[1]:
+                allocator.free_swa(request[0])
+                request[1] = False
+        elif op < 0.8 and requests:
+            indices, swa_live = requests.pop(rng.randrange(len(requests)))
+            (allocator.free if swa_live else allocator.free_full)(indices)
+        elif op < 0.9:
+            slot = allocator.mamba_allocator.alloc(1)
+            if slot is not None:
+                slots.append(slot)
+        elif slots:
+            allocator.mamba_allocator.free(slots.pop(rng.randrange(len(slots))))
+
+    def test_a_failed_ensure_leaves_no_reclaim_certificate(self):
+        """When ensure_capacity fails, the reclaim certificate must not hold:
+        decode eviction stops on it and frees nothing, so the check would retract
+        a request that a second ensure_capacity could have served."""
+        for lazy_compaction in (True, False):
+            for seed in range(8):
+                rng = random.Random(seed)
+                page_size = rng.choice([1, 2, 4])
+                _, allocator, _, _ = self._build(
+                    n_full=rng.choice([48, 64, 96]) * page_size,
+                    n_swa=rng.choice([12, 16, 24]) * page_size,
+                    n_state=rng.choice([6, 8, 12]),
+                    page_size=page_size,
+                    lazy_compaction=lazy_compaction,
+                )
+                chain = float_chain(allocator)
+                requests, slots = [], []
+                for step in range(120):
+                    self._churn_step(rng, allocator, requests, slots, page_size)
+                    for pages in range(1, 5):
+                        need = pages * page_size
+                        if (
+                            float_token_id_capacity(
+                                allocator.pricing_snapshot(), chain, need
+                            )
+                            and need <= allocator.available_size()
+                        ):
+                            continue
+                        probe = copy.deepcopy(allocator)
+                        # Opened before the outcome, so a served case reports an explicit pass.
+                        with self.subTest(
+                            lazy_compaction=lazy_compaction,
+                            seed=seed,
+                            step=step,
+                            need=need,
+                        ):
+                            if probe.ensure_capacity(need, need):
+                                continue
+                            self.assertFalse(
+                                float_reclaim_satisfied(
+                                    probe.pricing_snapshot(), chain, need
+                                )
+                            )
+                            self.assertEqual(probe.verify_byte_accounting(), [])
+
